note: TEMPORARY, for voice run 5 only (after two fresh reviews: 'go by' can be heard as 'go buy' after bag and phone; 'mug' mostly means cram in Indian English; 'Picked three?' sits right after 'Didn't pick three?'; 'number three's' hangs a possessive on the key word). 'lines' lists just the new lines; the film's lines are under 'held' and go back after the run. Reel 37: You're the Thief (working title). Draft 7. The narrator is the series voice (af_heart, 1.0). Lines that need a real pause are their own lines. Facts: docs/research.md. Four voice runs: 43373776324 (draft 5's lines), 43375946862 (the reworded and split lines), 43444575946 (a line for the middle of the clock) and 43445439756 (the bad-thief line again); every run's takes are in audio/vo_lab/takes. What the runs changed: 'Pick who you rob' ran together when it shared a line with 'You're the thief' (ear 1: 'Pekuyu Rob'), so the first line is two lines. 'Picked someone else?' lost its t in every take (both ears heard 'Pick someone else'), so that line became 'Didn't pick three? You'd make a bad thief.'; the cloud check on the mix then heard 'You'd make' as 'you make' through a phone speaker and in noise, so it's 'You're a bad thief.' The twist and the prison line are split so each half gets a set pause. 'Trust your gut.' (n02p) is said inside the three-second clock, so the voice stays with the viewer through the test; 'Don't think.' was voiced beside it and its first sound was flagged in every take. Voiced for comparison and not used (their takes are still in the lab folder): 'Pick who to rob.', 'They chose walks like number three's.', 'If you didn't pick three, you'd make a bad thief.', 'Picked three?' on its own, 'They're getting away.', 'Didn't pick three? Then you're a bad thief.'
ref_text: The night was cold and very quiet. Most of the street was asleep, and the lamps hummed over the empty road. Somewhere far away, a train rolled past, and then the silence came back.

lines.text: Men in prison for assault were asked who looked easy to rob.
If you picked three, you just robbed a man for being tired.
And if you did? You just robbed a man for being tired.

held.text: Same bag. Same phone. So what did you go by?
Take everything else away, and you still know which one's yours.
Men in prison for assault were asked who looked easy to mug.
They picked walks like number three's.
Didn't pick three? You're a bad thief.
Picked three? You just robbed a man for being tired.
Everyone walks like that some days,
and the real thief is watching for the day you do.
